title: University of Montana
description: The University of Montana's official brand guidelines define the heritage colours Griz Maroon (#70002E), Sunset Red (#F9423A) and Copper Climb (#ED8B00), and the secondary colours Wheat (#EFE8D4), Trail Sign Tan (#DFD1A7), Lubrecht Green (#1D3C34) and Glacier Sky (#BBDDE6).
